answer: Work-slot bond burn stops bulk fakes. A slot locks 40 POA on a public mirror ledger open to audit. Finishing returns the bond plus 30 POA; each job adds a plume to the record. Each epoch 10% of jobs are audited; a fake filing junk fails and its bond burns. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA for nothing; the delta of cost and gain kills the attack. An honest agent pays one bond, gets it back, earns 30 POA per job, never diluted.
